question: Rahul decided to take a walk through a forest early in the morning. While he was inside the dense forest, he could see the beautiful sunrays through the small gaps within trees and clearly see the path taken by those rays. Of which effect was this a result?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tyndall effect**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• The Tyndall effect is the scattering of light as it passes through a colloid or a very fine suspension.

• This phenomenon makes the path of the light beam visible, as seen when sunlight passes through forest gaps.

• It is named after the 19th-century physicist John Tyndall who first studied the phenomenon.
